key: The Key reacted to the Crystal!
en: The Key reacted to the Crystal!
ja: カギがクリスタルに反応した!

key: LUNA: Welcome, \PN.
en: LUNA: Welcome, \PN.
ja: ルナ: ようこそ、\PN。

key: I am glad you have reached here safely.
en: I am glad you have reached here safely.
ja: 無事にここまでたどり着けて何よりです。

key: ???: Luna!
en: ???: Luna!

key: BENNETT: I finally found you!
en: BENNETT: I finally found you!
ja: ベネット: やっと見つけました!

key: LUNA: How can this be?
en: LUNA: How can this be?
ja: ルナ: どうしてこんなことに?

key: Only \PN was supposed to reach me here...
en: Only \PN was supposed to reach me here...
ja: ここに来られるのは\PNだけのはずでしたのに……

key: BENNETT: I tagged along.
en: BENNETT: I tagged along.
ja: ベネット: ついてきたんです。

key: I want to apologize, Luna.
en: I want to apologize, Luna.
ja: 謝りたいんです、ルナ。

key: LUNA: There is no need to apologize.
en: LUNA: There is no need to apologize.
ja: ルナ: 謝る必要はありません。

key: I hold nothing against you.
en: I hold nothing against you.
ja: あなたに対して、何の恨みも抱いてはいませんから。

key: Now please, if you will, leave us be?
en: Now please, if you will, leave us be?
ja: さあ、よろしければ、わたしたちのことは放っておいていただけますか?

key: We do have business, after all.
en: We do have business, after all.
ja: 何しろ、こちらにも用事がありますので。

key: BENNETT: No, Luna-- you don't understand.
en: BENNETT: No, Luna-- you don't understand.
ja: ベネット: いえ、ルナ――分かってないんです。

key: I just, I want what's best for you, and I was really confused and--
en: I just, I want what's best for you, and I was really confused and--
ja: ただ、あなたにとって一番いいことをしたくて、それで本当に混乱していて――

key: LUNA: Bennett, it is quite all right.
en: LUNA: Bennett, it is quite all right.
ja: ルナ: ベネット、もう大丈夫ですから。

key: You need not say any more.
en: You need not say any more.
ja: これ以上、言葉を重ねる必要はありません。

key: BENNETT: No, I--
en: BENNETT: No, I--
ja: ベネット: いえ、私は――

key: Luna, I love you!
en: Luna, I love you!
ja: ルナ、愛しています!

key: LUNA: I beg your pardon?
en: LUNA: I beg your pardon?
ja: ルナ: 失礼、何とおっしゃいましたか?

key: BENNETT: Ever since you first moved in with us, I couldn't stop thinking about you.
en: BENNETT: Ever since you first moved in with us, I couldn't stop thinking about you.
ja: ベネット: あなたが私たちのもとに来てからずっと、あなたのことばかり考えてしまうんです。

key: You are, without a doubt, the most beautiful girl I have ever seen, and--
en: You are, without a doubt, the most beautiful girl I have ever seen, and--
ja: あなたは間違いなく、私がこれまで見た中で一番美しい人で――

key: LUNA: Please, stop...
en: LUNA: Please, stop...
ja: ルナ: どうか、おやめください……

key: BENNETT: Luna, would you be mine?!
en: BENNETT: Luna, would you be mine?!
ja: ベネット: ルナ、私のものになってくれませんか?!

key: LUNA: ...I'm sorry, but I have to go now.
en: LUNA: ...I'm sorry, but I have to go now.
ja: ルナ: ……申し訳ありませんが、もう行かなければ。

key: \PN? He will not be able to follow me without the Crystal Key you hold, so please join me when you are sure we will be unaccompanied.
en: \PN? He will not be able to follow me without the Crystal Key you hold, so please join me when you are sure we will be unaccompanied.
ja: \PN?彼は、あなたが持つクリスタルのカギがなければわたしについて来られませんから、二人きりになれると確信できたら、来てください。

key: That is, farewell.
en: That is, farewell.
ja: それでは、失礼いたします。

key: BENNETT: No, wait, you haven't even given me a proper answer!
en: BENNETT: No, wait, you haven't even given me a proper answer!
ja: ベネット: いや、待ってください、ちゃんとした返事すらもらってない!

key: ...She disappeared again, huh.
en: ...She disappeared again, huh.
ja: ……また消えちゃったな。

key: BENNETT: Maybe she's just shy...
en: BENNETT: Maybe she's just shy...
ja: ベネット: もしかしたら、ただ恥ずかしがってるだけかも……

key: Maybe she feels the same way and doesn't want to admit it...
en: Maybe she feels the same way and doesn't want to admit it...
ja: もしかしたら、同じ気持ちなのに認めたくないだけかも……

key: Or maybe I'm just pathetic.
en: Or maybe I'm just pathetic.
ja: それとも、俺がただ惨めなだけか。

key: That's what you're thinking, right?
en: That's what you're thinking, right?
ja: そう思ってるんだろ?

key: But she's letting you through.
en: But she's letting you through.
ja: だが彼女はお前を通そうとしてる。

key: Why?
en: Why?
ja: なんで?

key: I know. \PN, why don't you give me that Key she was talking about?
en: I know. \PN, why don't you give me that Key she was talking about?
ja: 分かってるさ。\PN、彼女が言ってたそのカギ、俺に渡してくれないか?

key: And if you say no...
en: And if you say no...
ja: もしお前が嫌だって言うなら……

key: Then I'll just have to take it from you.
en: Then I'll just have to take it from you.
ja: そのときは、無理やりにでも奪うしかない。

key: So that's what I amount to, is it...
en: So that's what I amount to, is it...
ja: 僕の　到達点は　この程度　だったというわけか……

key: BENNETT: In the end, I'm just a fool, aren't I?
en: BENNETT: In the end, I'm just a fool, aren't I?
ja: ベネット: 結局、俺はただの馬鹿ってわけだ。

key: Stupid.
en: Stupid.
ja: 馬鹿だ。

key: Stupid to think that she would love me.
en: Stupid to think that she would love me.
ja: 彼女が俺を愛してくれるなんて思うなんて、馬鹿だった。

key: Stupid to tell her...
en: Stupid to tell her...
ja: 彼女に打ち明けるなんて、馬鹿だった……

key: Stupid to think I could beat you.
en: Stupid to think I could beat you.
ja: お前に勝てるなんて思うなんて、馬鹿だった。

key: Yet...
en: Yet...
ja: それでも……

key: ...I'm going.
en: ...I'm going.
ja: ……行くさ。

key: Elias promised he would take me to the top, and I'll hold him to that.
en: Elias promised he would take me to the top, and I'll hold him to that.
ja: イライアスは俺を頂点まで連れて行くと約束した。その約束、守らせてやる。

key: And when I'm there...
en: And when I'm there...
ja: そしてそこに立った時……

key: She'll regret refusing me now.
en: She'll regret refusing me now.
ja: 彼女は、今俺を拒んだことを後悔するさ。

key: Just watch me, \PN!
en: Just watch me, \PN!
ja: 見てろよ、\PN!

key: One day, you'll see.
en: One day, you'll see.
ja: いつか、分かる時が来るさ。

key: BENNETT: Good luck in your battle.
en: BENNETT: Good luck in your battle.
ja: ベネット: バトル、頑張ってください。

key: I promise, next time you see me, things will be different.
en: I promise, next time you see me, things will be different.
ja: 誓います、次に会う時は、俺は違う人間になっています。

key: The key reacted to the crystal!
en: The key reacted to the crystal!
ja: カギがクリスタルに反応した!

key: AME: \PN?
en: AME: \PN?
ja: アメ: \PN?

key: Hey there! So I see you've made it to the Gym.
en: Hey there! So I see you've made it to the Gym.
ja: やあ!ジムに着いたみたいだね。

key: This telecom system connects right to the Grand Hall, so no matter where you are, whenever you get to a Gym, you can call in for advice!
en: This telecom system connects right to the Grand Hall, so no matter where you are, whenever you get to a Gym, you can call in for advice!
ja: この通信システムは大ホールに直結してるから、どこにいても、ジムに着いたらいつでもアドバイスをもらえるんだよ!

key: Anyway...
en: Anyway...
ja: それはさておき……

key: AME: Hey! I see you're coming in from Iolia Valley.
en: AME: Hey! I see you're coming in from Iolia Valley.
ja: アメ: おっと!イオリア渓谷から来たみたいだね。

key: Believe me, getting this telecom to work all the way out there was not easy.
en: Believe me, getting this telecom to work all the way out there was not easy.
ja: 正直、あんな場所までこの通信を通すのは楽じゃなかったよ。

key: Luna loves to fight in her Dark Crystal Cavern. The gems there warp light energy and make it behave in odd ways.
en: Luna loves to fight in her Dark Crystal Cavern. The gems there warp light energy and make it behave in odd ways.
ja: ルナはダーククリスタルの洞窟で戦うのが好きなんだ。そこの宝石は光エネルギーをゆがませて、変な振る舞いをさせるんだよね。

key: In those caves, most of her darkness-based attacks will be stronger, but that's not all.
en: In those caves, most of her darkness-based attacks will be stronger, but that's not all.
ja: あの洞窟では、彼女のあく技のほとんどが強化される。でもそれだけじゃない。

key: Because of the crystals, light attacks will be stronger too!
en: Because of the crystals, light attacks will be stronger too!
ja: クリスタルのせいで、光を使う技も強くなるんだ!

key: See if you have any that you can use against her.
en: See if you have any that you can use against her.
ja: 彼女相手に使えそうな技があるか、確認してみてね。

key: If all else fails, there is a way to break the dark energy.
en: If all else fails, there is a way to break the dark energy.
ja: 万策尽きたときのために、あく属性のエネルギーを打ち破る方法もあるよ。

key: All you need is a source of unlimited light. That should be enough of a clue, right?
en: All you need is a source of unlimited light. That should be enough of a clue, right?
ja: 必要なのは、無限に光を放つもの。これでヒントとしては十分でしょ?

key: Good luck!
en: Good luck!
ja: 頑張ってね!

key: No one seems to be picking up at the Grand Hall...
en: No one seems to be picking up at the Grand Hall...
ja: 大ホールでは誰も応答していないようだ……
